coverage_note: No items could be confirmed as newly published by RIKEN AIP (aip.riken.jp) or University of Tokyo AI labs within the 2026-08-29 to 2026-09-05 collection window. Direct WebFetch access to aip.riken.jp and www.riken.jp was blocked by the network egress proxy (EGRESS_BLOCKED), for the third consecutive run (following 2026-08-13 and 2026-08-29). To test whether this was target-specific, five unrelated control domains (www.google.com, en.wikipedia.org, web.archive.org, arxiv.org, openai.com) were also fetched via WebFetch and ALL failed identically with EGRESS_BLOCKED errors, confirming this is an environment-wide WebFetch restriction rather than a block specific to aip.riken.jp. WebSearch (a separate tool/pathway) remained functional and was used to search for RIKEN AIP and University of Tokyo AI news, but it only returns third-party search-index snippets, not verified primary-source page content, so no claims could be confirmed to primary-source standard and none are included as items to avoid reporting unverified or wrongly-dated information. The closest adjacent finding via WebSearch was a University of Tokyo Matsuo-Iwasawa Lab (weblab.t.u-tokyo.ac.jp) announcement about a nationwide call for trial/pilot high schools for a new AI curriculum, search-snippet-dated 2026-08-25 - this falls just before the collection window and could not be opened/verified via WebFetch, so it is deliberately excluded from 'items' rather than included with an uncertain date. Recommend the orchestrator retry aip.riken.jp access with an alternate fetch path/tool, or flag this as a recurring infrastructure gap for the human reviewer, since three consecutive runs have now been unable to directly access this priority-tier-3 source per CLAUDE.md section 2.
